nodes.name: SoftwareArtifact
nodes.definition: An information artifact created to specify, construct, configure, execute, test, or maintain software, independently of its physical storage medium.

nodes.name: FormalLanguage
nodes.definition: A system of symbols and formation rules defining a set of well-formed expressions.

nodes.name: ProgrammingLanguage
nodes.definition: A formal language whose expressions specify computations and whose meaning is defined by execution or evaluation rules.

nodes.name: MarkupLanguage
nodes.definition: A formal language for annotating the structure or interpretation of represented content.

nodes.name: QueryLanguage
nodes.definition: A formal language for expressing requests over data and, where specified, data transformations.

nodes.name: SpecificationLanguage
nodes.definition: A formal language for expressing required properties or behavior of a system.

nodes.name: SourceCode
nodes.definition: A program representation expressed in a programming language for interpretation, translation, or human inspection.

nodes.name: Bytecode
nodes.definition: An instruction representation intended for a specified virtual machine rather than directly for a physical processor.

nodes.name: MachineCode
nodes.definition: An instruction representation executable by a processor implementing the specified instruction set.

nodes.name: AlgorithmImplementation
nodes.definition: A concrete software representation that realizes an algorithm under specified input, output, and execution assumptions.
counterexamples: A single call to that function

nodes.name: FunctionDefinition
nodes.definition: Source code defining a callable computation with specified parameters and a body or implementation contract.

nodes.name: SoftwareModule
nodes.definition: A named unit of software with an explicit boundary for organizing definitions, dependencies, or visibility.

nodes.name: SoftwarePackage
nodes.definition: A distributable collection of software artifacts together with metadata describing installation or use.

nodes.name: SoftwareLibrary
nodes.definition: Reusable software exposed for use by other software through defined interfaces.

nodes.name: ExecutableArtifact
nodes.definition: A software artifact in a form accepted for execution by a specified runtime environment.

nodes.name: Script
nodes.definition: Source code intended to be executed as a sequence or entrypoint through an interpreter or comparable runtime.

nodes.name: SoftwareConfiguration
nodes.definition: Information selecting parameters, resources, or policies for a software system without necessarily changing its implementation.

nodes.name: TypeDefinition
nodes.definition: A declaration specifying a software type's values, operations, constraints, or representation.

nodes.name: InterfaceDefinition
nodes.definition: A specification of permitted interactions across a software boundary, including operations and exchanged values.

nodes.name: ApplicationProgrammingInterface
nodes.definition: An interface specification through which software components request behavior or exchange data.

nodes.name: DataSchema
nodes.definition: A specification of the structure and constraints of represented data.

nodes.name: SerializationFormat
nodes.definition: A formal representation convention for encoding structured values into transferable or storable sequences.

nodes.name: SoftwareSystem
nodes.definition: An organized collection of interacting software components providing a coherent set of capabilities.

nodes.name: OperatingSystem
nodes.definition: System software that manages computing resources and provides execution and service interfaces to applications.

nodes.name: RuntimeEnvironment
nodes.definition: Software services and conventions within which a program executes.

nodes.name: VirtualMachine
nodes.definition: A runtime environment presenting an abstract machine interface implemented by another computing system.

nodes.name: DatabaseManagementSystem
nodes.definition: Software for defining, storing, querying, updating, and controlling access to organized data.

nodes.name: WebBrowser
nodes.definition: Software that retrieves and presents web resources and executes supported web application behavior.

nodes.name: WebServer
nodes.definition: Software that accepts requests through web protocols and returns resources or application results.

nodes.name: SoftwareService
nodes.definition: A software component providing a defined capability through an interaction interface, commonly across process or network boundaries.

nodes.name: SoftwareFramework
nodes.definition: Reusable software defining an application structure and extension conventions within which application-specific behavior is supplied.

nodes.name: Middleware
nodes.definition: Software mediating communication or shared services between other applications or execution environments.

nodes.name: CommandLineInterface
nodes.definition: An interface specifying interaction through textual commands and arguments.

nodes.name: GraphicalUserInterface
nodes.definition: An interface specifying interaction through visual controls and displayed information.

nodes.name: EventInterface
nodes.definition: An interface specifying notifications and event payloads exchanged between components.

nodes.name: SoftwareTool
nodes.definition: Software whose primary purpose is to assist a user or another program in performing a defined technical task.

nodes.name: Compiler
nodes.definition: A software tool translating a source representation into another program representation according to specified semantics.
examples: A compiler translating source code to machine code

nodes.name: Interpreter
nodes.definition: A software tool that evaluates a program representation by carrying out its specified behavior.

nodes.name: Debugger
nodes.definition: A software tool for observing and controlling program execution to investigate behavior and defects.

nodes.name: Profiler
nodes.definition: A software tool measuring selected aspects of execution such as time, allocations, or resource use.

nodes.name: BuildTool
nodes.definition: A software tool coordinating transformations and dependencies needed to produce software artifacts.

nodes.name: PackageManager
nodes.definition: A software tool resolving, installing, updating, or removing software packages and their dependencies.

nodes.name: TestRunner
nodes.definition: A software tool executing selected tests and reporting their outcomes.

nodes.name: VersionControlTool
nodes.definition: A software tool recording and organizing revisions and relationships among artifact histories.

nodes.name: StaticAnalyzer
nodes.definition: A software tool deriving information about program behavior or structure without executing the analyzed program in the ordinary way.

nodes.name: Linter
nodes.definition: A static analyzer that reports configured code-quality, style, or suspicious-pattern findings.

nodes.name: CodeFormatter
nodes.definition: A software tool rewriting source presentation according to formatting rules while intending to preserve program meaning.

nodes.name: CodeEditor
nodes.definition: A software tool for reading and modifying source code.

nodes.name: IntegratedDevelopmentEnvironment
nodes.definition: A software tool combining code editing with development capabilities such as building, debugging, and navigation.

nodes.name: LanguageServer
nodes.definition: A software service providing programming-language analysis capabilities to clients through a defined protocol.

nodes.name: CommandShell
nodes.definition: A software tool interpreting commands to coordinate programs and operating-system services.

nodes.name: TerminalEmulator
nodes.definition: A software tool presenting a terminal interaction interface to another program or system.

nodes.name: ContainerRuntime
nodes.definition: A software tool creating and managing isolated execution environments using the host's operating-system facilities.

nodes.name: WorkloadOrchestrator
nodes.definition: A software tool coordinating placement, execution, and lifecycle of multiple workloads under declared policies.

nodes.name: DependencyScanner
nodes.definition: A software tool inspecting declared or resolved dependencies for properties such as versions, licenses, or known weaknesses.

nodes.name: DeploymentTool
nodes.definition: A software tool transferring, configuring, or activating a software release in a target environment.

nodes.name: ObservabilityTool
nodes.definition: A software tool collecting or analyzing signals used to understand system behavior.

nodes.name: DocumentationTool
nodes.definition: A software tool producing, validating, organizing, or presenting technical documentation.

nodes.name: ComputerSystem
nodes.definition: A physical computing device or organized collection of devices configured to execute computations, including its operational hardware organization.

nodes.name: Processor
nodes.definition: A device that carries out instructions or equivalent operations over represented data.

nodes.name: ComputingAccelerator
nodes.definition: A processor specialized to accelerate a class of computations relative to a more general execution path.

nodes.name: ComputerMemory
nodes.definition: A device component that retains encoded data for later access by a computing system.

nodes.name: RandomAccessMemory
nodes.definition: Computer memory supporting direct access to addressed locations without traversing preceding locations.

nodes.name: CacheMemory
nodes.definition: Computer memory used to retain copies of data to reduce expected access cost.

nodes.name: PersistentStorageDevice
nodes.definition: Computer memory designed to preserve encoded data across ordinary power interruption.

nodes.name: NetworkInterfaceDevice
nodes.definition: A device enabling a computing system to exchange signals with a communication network.

nodes.name: ComputerInputDevice
nodes.definition: A device converting external actions or signals into input usable by a computing system.

nodes.name: ComputerOutputDevice
nodes.definition: A device converting computer-produced data into externally accessible signals or effects.

nodes.name: ComputerNetwork
nodes.definition: An engineered arrangement of communicating computing devices and links that carries encoded information.

nodes.name: InstructionSet
nodes.definition: A specification of instructions and machine-visible behavior supported by a processor architecture or abstract machine.

nodes.name: DataStructure
nodes.definition: An organized representation of data together with structural constraints and intended access operations.

nodes.name: ArrayStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure whose elements are accessed through indices in an index domain.

nodes.name: LinkedList
nodes.definition: A data structure representing a sequence through links between element records.

nodes.name: StackStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure exposing removal in last-in-first-out order for inserted elements.

nodes.name: QueueStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure exposing removal in first-in-first-out order for inserted elements.

nodes.name: PriorityQueue
nodes.definition: A data structure selecting removable elements according to an assigned priority ordering.

nodes.name: HashTable
nodes.definition: A data structure using a hash function to locate entries associated with keys.

nodes.name: TreeDataStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure organizing records through an acyclic rooted parent-child arrangement.

nodes.name: GraphDataStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure representing vertices and edges, with optional attributes and direction.

nodes.name: SetDataStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure representing distinct members and operations based on membership.

nodes.name: MapDataStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure associating keys with values under a defined key-equivalence rule.

nodes.name: SearchAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm locating values or states satisfying a search condition within a specified search space.

nodes.name: SortingAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm arranging elements according to a specified ordering relation.

nodes.name: GraphAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm whose input, state, or result is defined through vertices, edges, and their relationships.

nodes.name: OptimizationAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm seeking values that improve or optimize an objective subject to specified constraints.

nodes.name: ConcurrentAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm defined for overlapping computations whose permitted interactions and orderings are part of its specification.

nodes.name: CryptographicAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm designed to provide a specified information-security property under explicit assumptions about keys and adversaries.

nodes.name: ComputationalProcess
nodes.definition: A process that transforms represented information through operations of a computing system.

nodes.name: SoftwareExecution
nodes.definition: A computational process realizing behavior specified by software in a particular execution environment.
examples: One invocation of a sorting implementation

nodes.name: ComputationResult
nodes.definition: Information produced by a computational process, interpreted relative to the producing operation and its inputs.
examples: The sorted list produced by one run

nodes.name: Compilation
nodes.definition: A computational process translating a program representation into another representation according to a compiler's rules.

nodes.name: ProgramInterpretation
nodes.definition: Software execution in which an interpreter evaluates a program representation.

nodes.name: ProgramLinking
nodes.definition: A computational process resolving and combining separately produced program units into a usable artifact.

nodes.name: Parsing
nodes.definition: A computational process deriving a structural representation from symbols according to a grammar.

nodes.name: LexicalAnalysis
nodes.definition: A computational process grouping an input symbol sequence into tokens according to lexical rules.

nodes.name: TypeChecking
nodes.definition: A computational process determining whether program expressions satisfy specified type rules.

nodes.name: GarbageCollection
nodes.definition: A computational process reclaiming storage determined no longer reachable or otherwise usable under the memory-management rules.

nodes.name: MemoryAllocation
nodes.definition: A computational process assigning storage resources for represented objects or execution needs.

nodes.name: ThreadExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution associated with a schedulable thread of control within an execution environment.

nodes.name: OperatingProcessExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution within an operating-system process and its assigned resources.

nodes.name: SystemCallExecution
nodes.definition: A computational process invoking an operation across the operating system's defined service boundary.

nodes.name: DataInputOutput
nodes.definition: A computational process transferring represented data across a specified computation or storage boundary.

nodes.name: NetworkTransmission
nodes.definition: A process carrying encoded information between endpoints through a communication network.

nodes.name: ConcurrentExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution in which multiple computations progress over overlapping intervals, without requiring simultaneous physical execution.

nodes.name: ParallelExecution
nodes.definition: Concurrent execution in which multiple computations execute at the same physical time on distinct execution resources.

nodes.name: DistributedExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution whose cooperating computations occur on multiple network-connected computing devices.

nodes.name: TransactionExecution
nodes.definition: A computational process treating a group of operations as a unit under declared commit, isolation, and failure semantics.

nodes.name: QueryExecution
nodes.definition: A computational process evaluating a request over data according to a query language and execution plan.

nodes.name: Serialization
nodes.definition: A computational process encoding structured values into a representation suitable for transfer or storage.

nodes.name: Deserialization
nodes.definition: A computational process reconstructing structured values from an encoded representation.

nodes.name: CommunicationProtocol
nodes.definition: A prescribed set of interaction rules governing messages, ordering, and participant behavior in communication.

nodes.name: NetworkAddress
nodes.definition: An identifier interpreted by a communication system to locate or route to an endpoint or interface.

nodes.name: NetworkPacket
nodes.definition: A bounded encoded unit of network communication interpreted according to a protocol.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.definition: An organized collection of data retained for coordinated retrieval and update.

nodes.name: DatabaseIndex
nodes.definition: A data structure maintained to accelerate specified access patterns over database contents.

nodes.name: TransactionLog
nodes.definition: An ordered record of transaction-related operations or outcomes used for recovery, audit, or replication.

nodes.name: ExecutionLog
nodes.definition: A record of events emitted while software executes, with interpretation determined by its logging schema and context.

nodes.name: ExecutionTrace
nodes.definition: A record preserving selected ordered or causally connected execution events for a run or request.

nodes.name: MetricTimeSeries
nodes.definition: A sequence of measured or derived metric values associated with observation times and dimensions.

nodes.name: SoftwareDevelopment
nodes.definition: An intentional process producing or modifying software and the artifacts needed to use and maintain it.

nodes.name: RequirementsElicitation
nodes.definition: Software development that discovers and records stakeholder needs, constraints, and required outcomes.

nodes.name: SoftwareDesign
nodes.definition: Software development that specifies the organization and behavior of a proposed software solution.

nodes.name: SoftwareConstruction
nodes.definition: Software development that creates executable implementations and associated implementation artifacts.

nodes.name: CodeReview
nodes.definition: Software development that examines code changes against correctness, maintainability, and other declared criteria.

nodes.name: Refactoring
nodes.definition: Software development that changes internal structure while intending to preserve specified externally observable behavior.

nodes.name: Debugging
nodes.definition: Software development that identifies and resolves causes of observed or suspected defects.

nodes.name: SoftwareTesting
nodes.definition: Software development that evaluates software behavior or properties against explicit expectations through selected examinations or executions.

nodes.name: UnitTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing focused on a deliberately bounded implementation unit under controlled dependencies.

nodes.name: IntegrationTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing focused on interactions across component or subsystem boundaries.

nodes.name: SystemTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing focused on a complete system's behavior against specified requirements.

nodes.name: RegressionTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing intended to detect loss of previously required behavior after a change.

nodes.name: PropertyBasedTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing that checks declared properties across generated or systematically varied inputs.

nodes.name: FuzzTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing that searches for failures using automatically produced or mutated input cases.

nodes.name: PerformanceTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing that measures responsiveness, throughput, capacity, or resource behavior under specified workloads.

nodes.name: AcceptanceTesting
nodes.definition: Software testing used to assess whether agreed acceptance conditions are satisfied.

nodes.name: StaticProgramAnalysis
nodes.definition: Software development that derives properties from program artifacts without ordinary execution of the target program.

nodes.name: FormalVerification
nodes.definition: Software development that establishes whether a formal model satisfies stated properties by a sound formal method relative to assumptions.

nodes.name: SoftwareBuild
nodes.definition: Software development that transforms source and dependencies into intended delivery or execution artifacts.

nodes.name: ContinuousIntegration
nodes.definition: Software development that repeatedly integrates changes and automatically evaluates the combined artifacts using declared checks.

nodes.name: SoftwareDeployment
nodes.definition: An intentional process installing, configuring, or activating software in a target environment.

nodes.name: ReleaseManagement
nodes.definition: Software development coordinating the selection, verification, identification, and delivery of a software release.

nodes.name: SoftwareIncidentResponse
nodes.definition: An intentional process investigating, containing, and resolving an operational software incident.

nodes.name: SoftwareMaintenance
nodes.definition: Software development modifying or supporting an existing software system after its initial delivery.

nodes.name: ThreatModeling
nodes.definition: Software design analyzing assets, adversaries, attack surfaces, and mitigations under an explicit threat scope.

nodes.name: RequirementsValidation
nodes.definition: Software development checking whether recorded requirements faithfully express relevant stakeholder needs and constraints.

nodes.name: SoftwareRequirement
nodes.definition: A statement of a needed software capability, quality, or constraint with a defined scope of applicability.

nodes.name: SoftwareSpecification
nodes.definition: An organized specification of required or intended software behavior, structure, or properties.

nodes.name: SoftwareDesignDocument
nodes.definition: An artifact recording a software design, its rationale, and relevant constraints.

nodes.name: TestCase
nodes.definition: An artifact specifying a test's conditions, actions or inputs, and expected evaluation criteria.

nodes.name: TestSuite
nodes.definition: An organized collection of test cases selected for a defined verification purpose.

nodes.name: TestFixture
nodes.definition: An artifact defining data, environment, or setup conditions needed to execute a test reproducibly.

nodes.name: TestDouble
nodes.definition: A software substitute used in a test in place of a collaborator under a declared simulation contract.

nodes.name: TestResult
nodes.definition: A record of the observed outcome of a particular test execution against its evaluation criteria.

nodes.name: BuildArtifact
nodes.definition: An artifact produced by a software build, identified relative to its inputs and build procedure.

nodes.name: DeploymentManifest
nodes.definition: Configuration declaring the intended resources, software artifacts, and settings of a deployment.

nodes.name: DependencyLockfile
nodes.definition: An artifact recording resolved dependency identities and versions for reproducible dependency selection.

nodes.name: SourceRepository
nodes.definition: An organized store of software source artifacts and their associated revision information.

nodes.name: ChangeSet
nodes.definition: An artifact representing a coherent collection of modifications relative to an identified prior state.

nodes.name: VersionCommit
nodes.definition: A version-control record identifying a revision and its recorded ancestry and metadata.

nodes.name: VersionBranch
nodes.definition: A version-control reference identifying an evolving line of revisions under a branch policy.

nodes.name: SoftwareRelease
nodes.definition: An identified collection of software artifacts selected for distribution or deployment under release conditions.

nodes.name: DefectReport
nodes.definition: A report asserting an observed or suspected mismatch between software behavior and a relevant expectation.

nodes.name: SoftwareDefect
nodes.definition: A property of a software artifact that can cause failure to satisfy an applicable requirement under specified conditions.

nodes.name: SoftwareVulnerability
nodes.definition: A software defect that can enable violation of a security objective under specified attacker and environment conditions.

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.definition: A computational process evaluating a claimed identity using specified credentials or evidence.

nodes.name: Authorization
nodes.definition: A computational process deciding whether a requested action is permitted under applicable access policies.

nodes.name: ExecutionSandboxing
nodes.definition: A computational process enforcing a restricted execution boundary for software activity.

nodes.name: AccessPolicy
nodes.definition: A specification of conditions under which subjects may perform actions on resources.

nodes.name: Encryption
nodes.definition: A computational process transforming plaintext into ciphertext under a cryptographic scheme and key assumptions.

nodes.name: SoftwareLicense
nodes.definition: A statement of permissions, conditions, and restrictions governing use of specified software or related artifacts.

nodes.name: ServiceLevelObjective
nodes.definition: A specified target for a service metric over an identified population and evaluation interval.

nodes.name: ComputingResourceLimit
nodes.definition: A specified bound on consumption or allocation of a computing resource within an identified scope.

nodes.name: ExecutionEnvironmentState
nodes.definition: The relevant configuration and available resources of an environment during a software execution.

nodes.name: SoftwareFailureEvent
nodes.definition: An occurrence in which delivered software behavior fails to satisfy an applicable requirement in its operating context.

nodes.name: RaceCondition
nodes.definition: A software defect in which required behavior depends incorrectly on the relative timing of concurrent operations.

nodes.name: DeadlockState
nodes.definition: An execution state in which a set of participants cannot progress because each awaits resources or actions held by others in the set.

nodes.name: SoftwareDeveloperRole
nodes.definition: A contextual role involving responsibility for constructing or modifying software.

nodes.name: SoftwareMaintainerRole
nodes.definition: A contextual role involving responsibility for the ongoing integrity and evolution of a software artifact.

nodes.name: SoftwareReviewerRole
nodes.definition: A contextual role involving examination of software changes against declared review criteria.

nodes.name: SoftwareArchitecture
nodes.definition: An organized description of significant software structures, interactions, and constraints guiding system construction and evolution.

nodes.name: SoftwareDesignPattern
nodes.definition: A reusable description of a software design solution and its applicability conditions rather than a particular implementation.

nodes.name: TechnicalDebt
nodes.definition: A property of a software system in which earlier implementation or design choices impose identifiable future maintenance or change costs.

nodes.name: AlgorithmicComplexity
nodes.definition: A property describing how an algorithm's required resources scale with a specified input measure and computational model.

nodes.name: DependencyContract
nodes.definition: A specification of assumptions and guarantees governing a component's use of another component or resource.

nodes.name: ErrorHandling
nodes.definition: A computational process detecting, representing, or responding to conditions classified as execution errors.

nodes.name: ComputationalRollback
nodes.definition: A computational process restoring a specified earlier state after a failed or cancelled operation under a declared recovery model.

nodes.name: IdempotentOperation
nodes.definition: An operation specification for which repeated application has the same relevant effect as one application under its stated equivalence and conditions.

nodes.name: ReproducibleBuild
nodes.definition: A software build whose specified inputs and environment yield equivalent outputs under a declared reproducibility criterion.

nodes.name: DependencyResolution
nodes.definition: A computational process selecting artifact versions or providers satisfying declared dependency constraints.

nodes.name: DataMigration
nodes.definition: A computational process transforming or moving stored data to satisfy a target schema or storage arrangement.

nodes.name: SchemaValidation
nodes.definition: A computational process checking represented data against declared structural and value constraints.

nodes.name: ProgrammingConstruct
nodes.definition: A syntactic or semantic form specified by a programming language for expressing computation, declarations, or control.

nodes.name: ProgrammingExpression
nodes.definition: A programming construct whose evaluation yields a value or values according to the language semantics, possibly with effects.
examples: An addition expression in source code
counterexamples: A mathematical variable independently of a programming language

nodes.name: ProgrammingStatement
nodes.definition: A programming construct specifying an instruction or control action within the language's statement structure.
counterexamples: The runtime action of returning from one call

nodes.name: VariableReferenceExpression
nodes.definition: A programming expression referring to a binding resolved under the language's naming and scope rules.

nodes.name: LiteralExpression
nodes.definition: A programming expression directly denoting a value according to the language's literal syntax.

nodes.name: CallExpression
nodes.definition: A programming expression invoking a callable entity with supplied arguments under the language's call semantics.

nodes.name: LambdaExpression
nodes.definition: A programming expression defining an anonymous callable computation with parameters and a body.

nodes.name: AssignmentStatement
nodes.definition: A programming statement establishing or changing a binding or stored value according to the language's assignment semantics.

nodes.name: ReturnStatement
nodes.definition: A programming statement completing the current function invocation and optionally supplying a return value.

nodes.name: ConditionalStatement
nodes.definition: A programming statement selecting among execution branches according to evaluated conditions.

nodes.name: LoopStatement
nodes.definition: A programming statement specifying repeated execution under an iteration or termination rule.

nodes.name: ExceptionHandlerConstruct
nodes.definition: A programming construct specifying behavior for selected exceptional outcomes arising within a defined protected scope.

nodes.name: ImportDeclaration
nodes.definition: A programming construct making definitions or modules available through the language's import and name-resolution rules.

nodes.name: VariableDeclaration
nodes.definition: A programming construct introducing a named binding and any specified type, lifetime, or initialization constraints.

nodes.name: FunctionDeclaration
nodes.definition: A programming construct declaring a callable interface, which may be separate from the implementation body under the language's rules.

nodes.name: VariableBinding
nodes.definition: An association between a program name or reference and its denoted value, location, or definition within an identified scope and execution context.

nodes.name: LexicalScopeRule
nodes.definition: A name-resolution rule determining visibility from the lexical organization of program text rather than only the current call history.

nodes.name: ControlFlowStructure
nodes.definition: A specification of permitted execution orderings and branch transitions among operations of a program.

nodes.name: ControlFlowGraph
nodes.definition: A graph data structure representing possible execution transitions between program operations or blocks.

nodes.name: Closure
nodes.definition: A callable software value combining executable code with bindings from an associated environment needed by that code.
examples: A function value retaining an outer lexical binding

nodes.name: Continuation
nodes.definition: A software representation of the remainder of a computation from a specified control point, together with the state required by its semantics.

nodes.name: Coroutine
nodes.definition: A software computation definition or resumable value supporting suspension and later resumption under a specified control protocol.

nodes.name: CoroutineExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution following a coroutine's suspension and resumption protocol.

nodes.name: AsynchronousExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution that separates initiation of an operation from notification or retrieval of its completion under an asynchronous interaction contract.

nodes.name: ExceptionRaising
nodes.definition: A computational process signaling an exceptional outcome according to the language or runtime's exceptional-control semantics.

nodes.name: ExceptionHandling
nodes.definition: Error handling that selects and executes a response to a signaled exception under a defined propagation and handler-selection rule.

nodes.name: ExceptionValue
nodes.definition: An information value describing an exceptional condition and carried through a language or runtime's exception protocol.

nodes.name: ProgrammingTypeSystem
nodes.definition: A system of rules assigning and checking software types to constrain or describe permitted program operations.

nodes.name: StaticTypeSystem
nodes.definition: A programming type system whose relevant judgments are checked from program artifacts before their ordinary execution.

nodes.name: RuntimeTypeSystem
nodes.definition: A programming type system whose relevant judgments or checks are performed using runtime values during execution.

nodes.name: TypeInferenceAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm deriving type assignments from program structure and constraints without requiring every type to be explicitly annotated.

nodes.name: ProgrammingTypeParameter
nodes.definition: A programming construct representing a type-level parameter of a generic definition rather than an ordinary runtime value argument.

nodes.name: SoftwarePolymorphism
nodes.definition: A property of a software interface or construct supporting behavior over multiple relevant types under an explicit dispatch or abstraction rule.

nodes.name: SubtypePolymorphism
nodes.definition: Software polymorphism permitting values of specified subtypes to be used through a supertype interface under its behavioral contract.

nodes.name: ParametricPolymorphism
nodes.definition: Software polymorphism defining behavior through type parameters without relying on arbitrary properties of a particular parameter type.

nodes.name: AdHocPolymorphism
nodes.definition: Software polymorphism selecting among separately defined behaviors according to argument types or an explicit dispatch rule.

nodes.name: RecursiveAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm defining part of its computation through applications of the same algorithm to related subproblems, with termination conditions specified separately.

nodes.name: RecursiveExecution
nodes.definition: Software execution containing nested invocations of the same or mutually recursive computations.

nodes.name: TailRecursiveAlgorithm
nodes.definition: A recursive algorithm whose recursive calls occur in tail position so no additional computation is required after those calls return.

nodes.name: DivideConquerAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm solving a problem by decomposing it into subproblems, solving them, and combining their results.

nodes.name: DynamicProgrammingAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm organizing solutions of overlapping subproblems through retained intermediate results according to a dependency recurrence.

nodes.name: GreedyAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm constructing a solution by locally preferred choices under a specified selection criterion, with global optimality requiring separate justification.

nodes.name: BacktrackingAlgorithm
nodes.definition: An algorithm exploring candidate solutions incrementally and withdrawing choices when they cannot satisfy specified constraints.

nodes.name: BinarySearchAlgorithm
nodes.definition: A search algorithm repeatedly narrowing an ordered search interval by comparing the target with a middle candidate.

nodes.name: BreadthFirstSearch
nodes.definition: A search algorithm exploring reachable graph vertices in nondecreasing number of traversed edges from its starting frontier.

nodes.name: DepthFirstSearch
nodes.definition: A search algorithm extending the current path into unexplored adjacent vertices before backtracking to remaining alternatives.

nodes.name: DijkstraAlgorithm
nodes.definition: A graph algorithm finding shortest paths from a source by settling the least tentative-distance vertex under nonnegative edge-weight assumptions.

nodes.name: TopologicalOrderingAlgorithm
nodes.definition: A graph algorithm producing a vertex ordering consistent with the directed edges of a directed acyclic graph.

nodes.name: MergeSort
nodes.definition: A sorting algorithm ordering subcollections and combining them by an order-preserving merge operation.

nodes.name: QuickSort
nodes.definition: A sorting algorithm partitioning elements relative to a pivot and recursively sorting the resulting partitions under a specified partition scheme.

nodes.name: HeapSort
nodes.definition: A sorting algorithm using a heap ordering to repeatedly select the next extreme element for the output order.

nodes.name: BinarySearchTree
nodes.definition: A tree data structure with at most two children per node and a declared ordering invariant separating left and right descendant keys.

nodes.name: BalancedBinarySearchTree
nodes.definition: A binary search tree maintaining a height or balance constraint intended to bound search and update path lengths.

nodes.name: AVLTree
nodes.definition: A balanced binary search tree whose left and right subtree heights differ by at most one at every node.

nodes.name: RedBlackTree
nodes.definition: A balanced binary search tree using node colors and path invariants to maintain a logarithmic bound on height.

nodes.name: BinaryHeap
nodes.definition: A complete binary tree data structure satisfying a declared heap-order relation between each node and its children.

nodes.name: Trie
nodes.definition: A tree data structure storing keys by shared prefixes along paths under a specified key-symbol decomposition.

nodes.name: DisjointSetStructure
nodes.definition: A data structure maintaining a partition into disjoint subsets and supporting representative lookup and subset union.

nodes.name: BloomFilter
nodes.definition: A probabilistic membership data structure using a bit array and hash mappings, permitting false-positive answers under its standard insertion-only contract.

nodes.name: SynchronizationProtocol
nodes.definition: A procedure constraining interaction ordering among concurrent participants to establish declared coordination properties.

nodes.name: MutexProtocol
nodes.definition: A synchronization protocol allowing at most one participating owner in a designated critical region at a time.

nodes.name: SemaphoreProtocol
nodes.definition: A synchronization protocol controlling acquisition and release of a counted set of permits under specified blocking semantics.

nodes.name: ReadWriteLockProtocol
nodes.definition: A synchronization protocol permitting concurrent readers or an exclusive writer for a protected resource under a stated fairness policy.

nodes.name: MemoryOwnershipRule
nodes.definition: A specification assigning responsibility for the lifetime and permitted use of a program's memory-backed value or resource.

nodes.name: MemoryBorrowingRule
nodes.definition: A specification permitting temporary access to a resource while constraining access or lifetime relative to an owning reference.

nodes.name: MemorySafety
nodes.definition: A property of program behavior respecting specified valid bounds, lifetimes, and access rules for memory objects.

nodes.name: ProgrammingParadigm
nodes.definition: An organizing model for expressing and structuring computation through characteristic abstractions and composition rules.

nodes.name: ImperativeParadigm
nodes.definition: A programming paradigm expressing computation through commands that change program state.

nodes.name: FunctionalParadigm
nodes.definition: A programming paradigm organizing computation through function evaluation and composition, with effect constraints specified by the language or discipline.

nodes.name: ObjectOrientedParadigm
nodes.definition: A programming paradigm organizing behavior and state through objects and their interaction interfaces.

nodes.name: LogicProgrammingParadigm
nodes.definition: A programming paradigm specifying relations and goals whose solutions are sought through a defined inference or search procedure.
